issues.issue: Did the RAD unreasonably refuse to admit the first four items of new evidence under s. 110(4) IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: RAD should have admitted the first four new documents; his mother's advanced age explains the delay in producing them.
issues.result_quote: reasonably explains why it was not satisfied with the Applicant’s explanation for not producing the proposed new evidence

issues.issue: Did the RAD unreasonably refuse an oral hearing under s. 110(6) IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: RAD erred in denying an oral hearing on the new evidence.
issues.result_quote: that the decision by the RAD not to hold an oral hearing is reasonable, in the circumstances

issues.issue: Was the RAD's identity assessment, and its weighing of the admitted evidence, reasonable?
issues.applicant_position: RAD gave little or no probative value to the admitted evidence and erred in its identity assessment.
issues.result_quote: I would therefore dismiss this application for judicial review
